violations.description: General employee practices. — --Food employee observed without proper hair restraint.
Prep/vegetable sink. — --Prep sink was not plumbed with a physical air gap on the drain line.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room was not provided with a self closing door.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Food debris/water pooling at prep table cooler along wall juncture. Needs cleaning. Mop up pooling water in walk in cooler.

General premises. — --Opening to outside or portion of building that is not part of the food establishment, was not protected against the entry of insects and rodents. Self closing door mechanism at East delivery door not connected and needs repair.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Recommend peeling protective transportation film from under counter reach in cooler in prep area.
Prep/vegetable sink. — --Prep sink was not plumbed with a physical air gap on the drain line.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room was not provided with a self closing door.

General premises. — --Opening to outside or portion of building that is not part of the food establishment, was not protected against the entry of insects and rodents. East delivery door has broken self closing mechanism.
